metadata.name: Synapse Detailed Pipeline Architecture
metadata.description: Detection-first lecture context processing followed by durable evidence, explanation text and speech stages, with private on-demand intent, conditional inference, independent checkpoints and guarded delivery.
metadata.statusSemantics: implemented means source-connected behavior, not successful runtime execution. code_supported means statically traced. No tests, applications, builds, inference or external services were executed for this export.
metadata.flowSemantics: Flows are directed subgraphs, not necessarily one sequential edge list. Control/job edges and payload edges have distinct data types. Parallel branches join before synchronization. Alternative providers and cache paths must not all activate together.
metadata.animationSemantics: Logical illustrations of eligible code paths, never measured live traffic. Gesture edges are partial and excluded from active phases. No processing durations or presentation aesthetics are defined.
metadata.concurrencySemantics: Initial transcription and keyframes run in two threads. Interaction scan follows their join. Preparation has one evidence, one text and one speech consumer; different jobs may overlap across stages subject to resource locks and bounded handoffs.
metadata.effectiveConfiguration: Unverified. Model names and numerical limits are source declarations, not private environment values or deployed configuration.
metadata.artifactSemantics: The existence of a snapshot does not establish usability. Failed snapshots may be persisted for diagnostics; only usable current evidence proceeds to strict visual synthesis. Text and complete audio have different cache gates.

groups.label: Requests and Durable Coordination
groups.description: FastAPI entry, owned intent, processing jobs and preparation lifecycle.

groups.label: Lecture Context Extraction
groups.description: Video identity, parallel audio/frame extraction, separate optional Gesture Detection and intervention synchronization.

groups.label: Visual Understanding and Evidence
groups.description: Per-target resolution, bounded image inference, canonical assembly, refinement and evidence checkpoints.

groups.label: Context and Explanation Synthesis
groups.description: Speech alignment, coverage planning, prompt selection, selected text model and text checkpoint.

groups.label: Speech and Accessible Delivery
groups.description: Local explanation speech, attempt audio, publication, API response and frontend consumption.

groups.label: Persistent Storage
groups.description: SQL job/metadata records and managed local artifacts; not a broker or separate vector store.

nodes.label: Pipeline API Entry
nodes.description: Validated video jobs, retained /process entry, preparation/explain/retry requests, owned requests and stream subscriptions.

nodes.label: Persistent Video Jobs
nodes.description: Create/join, cache inspection, resource admission, lease/generation ownership, detection invocation and mode scheduling.

nodes.label: Owned On-Demand Intent
nodes.description: Authenticated lecture interest, idempotent operation identity, requested timestamps and review/saved-result links. Initial processing must already exist.

nodes.label: Video Identity and Ingestion
nodes.description: Validate YouTube ID, create video artifact directories and fork detection-only extraction. This does not itself run VLM, LLM or TTS.

nodes.label: Caption Acquisition
nodes.description: Persistent transcription worker first attempts YouTube captions and serializes timestamped entries. Caption failure selects Whisper fallback.

nodes.label: Audio Acquisition and Whisper
nodes.description: URL auto mode reads yt-dlp/FFmpeg PCM then transcribes with faster-whisper base. Alternative file/download mode exists; this is not incremental real-time transcript streaming.

nodes.label: Frame Decode and Sampling
nodes.description: Resolve source stream/metadata, decode FFmpeg BGR frames at declared sample rate and filter mostly blank candidates.

nodes.label: CLIP Features and Complexity
nodes.description: Local CLIP ViT-B/32 embeddings/category comparisons plus independent OpenCV complexity features; similarity scores are not calibrated probabilities.

nodes.label: Pedagogical Keyframe Selection
nodes.description: Adaptive conceptual scenes, representative candidates, spacing and temporal coverage; semantic similarity is checked but does not veto the best frame of each scene.

nodes.label: Gesture Detection
nodes.description: Analyzes instructor gestures and interaction cues. The connected path optionally records interaction episodes and representative frames; orchestrator disables the MediaPipe hand path. Reliable semantic association remains unverified.

nodes.label: Intervention Synchronization
nodes.description: Match transcript/keyframes, score intervention triggers, suppress closely spaced candidates and optionally fuse interaction episodes.

nodes.label: Persist Lecture Context
nodes.description: Job owner writes shared video/transcript/intervention records and intervention JSON, then notifies waiting requests and schedules modes.

nodes.label: Three-Stage Preparation
nodes.description: Evidence/text/speech workers, priority, four-item bounded handoffs, short transactions, stage checkpoints and lease tracking.

nodes.label: Resolve Evidence Target and Cache
nodes.description: Load shared target; check complete cache; serialize visual extraction; resolve auto/manual, transcript and current snapshot alternatives.

nodes.label: Requested Timestamp Frame
nodes.description: For evidence_kind=auto, use yt-dlp/FFmpeg to obtain requested.jpg under ownership guards. Acquisition failure explicitly changes the target to transcript-only.

nodes.label: Image, Prompt and Context Budget
nodes.description: Build category-aware compact observation prompt; Modal converts bounded RGB JPEG, counts dispatched multimodal tokens through serving /tokenize and bounds requested completion.

nodes.label: Selected VLM Inference
nodes.description: Default authenticated Modal/vLLM Qwen3-VL-8B FP8; separately selected local Qwen2-VL GGUF path. Modal failure never silently falls back to local.

nodes.label: Parse and Canonicalize Evidence
nodes.description: Parse compact JSON, classify finish/truncation failures, assemble backend metadata and validate canonical schema/diagnostics. Local GGUF has its own analysis path and is not assumed equivalent.

nodes.label: Conditional Focused Readings
nodes.description: Successful Modal overview may request at most three focused crop/panel readings using the same model; precision-sensitive conflicts remain explicit.

nodes.label: Snapshot Checkpoint and Usability Gate
nodes.description: Persist quality-versioned vlm_snapshot.json, including failed diagnostics; only usable current canonical evidence passes to strict visual synthesis.

nodes.label: Explicit Transcript-Only Target
nodes.description: Requires nonempty saved speech and carries _transcript_only context. It skips visual analysis; ordinary failed visual extraction is not silently relabeled as a successful visual explanation.

nodes.label: Align Teaching Context
nodes.description: Match teacher passage and contiguous nearby captions around frame timestamp; active get_aligned_context window is independent of explanation depth.

nodes.label: Visual and Speech Coverage
nodes.description: Deterministic atomic-fact matching labels spoken_explicit, spoken_partial, unspoken, uncertain_match and not_usable; this is not a separate AI planner.

nodes.label: Bounded Explanation Inputs
nodes.description: Select canonical evidence, aligned teacher passage, coverage attention and category/depth instructions; compute input hash and reuse matching text checkpoints where valid.

nodes.label: Explanation LLM Synthesis
nodes.description: Ollama mistral:latest default; explicitly configured Modal Ministral or Gemini alternatives. Require complete responses; provider-supported structured output/source review is conditional.

nodes.label: Text and Provenance Checkpoint
nodes.description: Atomic depth-specific text plus .text-generation.json enables speech recovery without accepting stale evidence/provider/input hashes.

nodes.label: Local Explanation TTS
nodes.description: Shared CPU Pocket TTS alba with Kokoro af_heart fallback, priority/admission and checked PCM-to-MP3 encoding. Midstream failure terminates the attempt rather than splicing provider audio.

nodes.label: Attempt Stream and Final Audio
nodes.description: Attempt-scoped NDJSON text/start/audio/complete/error records with PCM chunks; completed depth-specific MP3 and generation manifest are separate from a live partial stream.

nodes.label: Validate and Publish Result
nodes.description: Under current ownership, validate complete artifact, persist Explanation metadata, mark preparation ready and link owned requests to preserved results.

nodes.label: API Text and Audio Delivery
nodes.description: Preparation polling and cached text/audio retrieval; NDJSON subscription follows an admitted current audio attempt. Typed errors remain distinct from ready results.

nodes.label: Accessible Frontend Playback
nodes.description: Receives JSON text/status, validated completed audio or PCM events; HTML Audio/Web Audio and lecture/conversation guards control output.

nodes.label: SQL State and Metadata
nodes.description: SQLAlchemy/local-default SQLite records for videos, transcripts, moments, jobs, preparations, explanations and private request/session state.

nodes.label: Local Pipeline Artifacts
nodes.description: Per-video transcript/keyframe/interaction files; per-target evidence and text/audio checkpoints; temporary and stream files with guarded publication.

nodes.label: Failure, Cancellation and Recovery
nodes.description: Leases, heartbeat/generation fences, retry budgets, waiting-for-VLM deferral, text recovery and startup/shutdown maintenance. A state transition is not another inference model.

flows.label: Initial Video Context
flows.description: Fresh video job forks extraction, joins, selects intervention moments, persists and schedules modes; not a full-video VLM pass.
flows.trigger: Valid processing request and absent/invalid context cache

flows.label: Caption or Whisper Transcription
flows.description: Caption success and audio/Whisper fallback are alternatives inside one transcription worker.

flows.label: Representative Frame Processing
flows.description: Sample, featurize, classify, select and persist images before intervention matching.

flows.label: Optional Gesture Detection
flows.description: Separate partial module consumes same source after extraction join; optional episode fusion, not reliable semantic gesture extraction.
flows.trigger: Interaction path enabled and detector/fusion succeeds

flows.label: Synchronize and Persist Context
flows.description: Join transcript/keyframes, select/fuse candidates, persist and notify waiting requests.

flows.label: Generate Usable Visual Evidence
flows.description: Claim target, select adapter, infer, parse/canonicalize, conditionally refine, persist and gate. Failed diagnostic snapshots stop before text handoff.
flows.trigger: Visual target without current evidence cache

flows.label: Grounded Explanation Text
flows.description: Align speech, match atomic visual coverage, bound source inputs and generate or reuse completed text.
flows.trigger: Usable visual evidence or matching snapshot

flows.label: Explanation Speech and Delivery
flows.description: Text checkpoint enters CPU speech; partial attempt streams and validated complete audio have different delivery gates.
flows.trigger: Checkpointed text or complete cached generation

flows.label: Owned Explanation Request
flows.description: Requires previously started lecture processing and owned active interest. Context may still be pending; manual auto target attempts a requested frame and has an explicit transcript-only alternative.

flows.label: Reuse Context and Checkpoints
flows.description: Different cache levels resume different stages. Complete current cache can bypass inference; text-only cache resumes speech.

flows.label: Failure and Recovery
flows.description: Classified failures and lease/cancellation/readiness states can retry/defer/recover only when policy permits; errors do not imply successful model work.
flows.trigger: Stage failure, stale ownership, cancellation, startup recovery or dependency unavailability

flows.label: Separately Selected Local VLM
flows.description: Retained local GGUF delegate bypasses normal compact assembly; snapshot still faces usability gate. Successful strict canonical integration is unverified, so this path has no active success animation.

animationPhases.label: Admit Lecture Context Job
animationPhases.description: Create/join durable work; fresh context invokes detection-only ingestion.

animationPhases.label: Extract Speech and Frames in Parallel
animationPhases.description: Show transcription and frame streams together; choose caption success or Whisper fallback, never both as mandatory. Gesture scan follows the join and is not a third mandatory branch.

animationPhases.label: Join and Select Intervention Context
animationPhases.description: Join the two extraction threads, match transcript/keyframes, persist and schedule preparation. Gesture node remains visible but inactive in confirmed-flow animation.
conditions: both extraction threads joined; result accepted

animationPhases.label: Resolve Learner Priority Intent
animationPhases.description: Owned request waits for context, resumes existing work if applicable, or prioritizes shared preparation. Shared prepare/explain requests also enter the existing manager.
conditions: owned active lecture session for private request

animationPhases.label: Claim Evidence Target
animationPhases.description: Claim lease, test complete cache and evidence kind; choose visual inference, reused snapshot or manual/transcript alternative.

animationPhases.label: Resolve Requested Frame or Speech-Only Target
animationPhases.description: Auto target attempts one timestamp frame; unavailable media selects explicit transcript-only context, not invented visual evidence.

animationPhases.label: Construct and Dispatch VLM Request
animationPhases.description: For normal visual target or acquired requested frame, build Modal image/prompt, exact context budget and model request. Alternate local provider is separate and is not represented by this success phase.

animationPhases.label: Read Precision-Sensitive Details Conditionally
animationPhases.description: Same model performs bounded focused readings only for eligible successful Modal overview. Return conflicts/uncertainty rather than infer scientific corrections.

animationPhases.label: Persist and Gate Visual Evidence
animationPhases.description: Persist normal/refined or diagnostic snapshot. Only usable current evidence proceeds; a failed saved snapshot takes the failure scenario.
conditions: p30 only when refinement bypassed; refined result already arrives through p29
snapshot must pass usability before text stage

animationPhases.label: Align Speech and Reconcile Visual Coverage
animationPhases.description: Usable evidence handoff meets saved transcript; align contiguous teaching context and assign atomic fact coverage before bounded synthesis input selection.

animationPhases.label: Synthesize and Checkpoint Explanation Text
animationPhases.description: One selected explanation provider receives grounded visual inputs or an explicitly transcript-only prompt; accepted completed text is checkpointed independently of audio.

animationPhases.label: Generate Speech in Independent Stage
animationPhases.description: Queue text to CPU TTS, check PCM chunks and encode final MP3. Different items can occupy evidence/text/speech stages concurrently under resource gates.
animationPhases.overlapScope: different items across evidence, text and speech workers

animationPhases.label: Publish Complete Current Result
animationPhases.description: Validate complete audio/current cache, commit metadata and expose ready retrieval. A partial audio stream alone does not satisfy this phase.

animationPhases.label: Deliver Current Audio Attempt
animationPhases.description: Subscriber receives current attempt NDJSON including text readiness, checked PCM and terminal status while final audio may still be generating.
conditions: valid admitted stream subscription and active attempt

animationPhases.label: Retrieve Text and Completed Audio
animationPhases.description: Read current metadata and validated files; frontend renders text and applies playback guards to explanation audio.
conditions: ready/current complete artifact or explicit status response

animationPhases.label: Reuse Lecture Context
animationPhases.description: Valid context bypasses detection and schedules modes without claiming explanations are already ready.

animationPhases.label: Reuse Current Usable Evidence
animationPhases.description: Reuse snapshot after usability and quality-version checks, then resume aligned text processing.

animationPhases.label: Reuse Matching Text Checkpoint
animationPhases.description: Current input, provider and evidence hashes permit text reuse. Resume speech or reuse a matching final audio generation.
conditions: matching text checkpoint; p68 only for complete current audio

animationPhases.label: Reuse Complete Explanation
animationPhases.description: A current complete text/audio pair bypasses inference and is delivered through normal response boundaries.

animationPhases.label: Report Failure or Defer Work
animationPhases.description: Error-scenario activation only: unusable evidence, failed/incomplete text, interrupted speech or stale ownership produces status/error. Never depict this phase as successful inference.
conditions: select only the actual failing origin in the illustrated scenario

animationPhases.label: Recover Eligible Durable Work
animationPhases.description: Only eligible jobs are requeued/resumed. Deferred VLM readiness, exhausted/permanent failures and ownership fencing have distinct terminal/retry behavior.
conditions: retry budget, readiness and lifecycle policy allow
